effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
purpose:
I own a growing high-end interior design and renovation firm, and we’re about to enter a business development and referral partnership with a luxury real estate team that says they can consistently bring us renovation clients for kitchens, baths, whole-home remodels, staging upgrades, and turnkey furnishing packages. Right now everything has been discussed through calls, texts, and informal promises, and I need a serious agreement between my company and their team.

We need clear compensation terms with a $10,000 monthly retainer plus 7% commission on signed projects they directly source, payable only after the client’s deposit clears, with chargeback/clawback if the client cancels within 45 days. We also need reimbursement rules for approved events, travel, photography, and paid ads.

Need ownership and use rules for leads, CRM records, before/after photography, design boards, staging photos, ad creatives, landing pages, newsletter lists, and social media assets. Need exclusivity in our metro area only if they generate at least 10 qualified leads per month. Need rules on use of each party’s name, logo, testimonials, and project photos.

Need confidentiality around pricing, margins, vendors, subcontractors, customer lists, and pipeline data. Need non-circumvention so they cannot bypass us and go directly to our vendors or clients, and non-solicit so neither side poaches staff or contractors. Need FTC-compliant advertising language, approval rights for promotions, quality-control language so they cannot overpromise timelines or financing claims, a morals/reputation clause, term and renewal, termination for nonperformance or scandal, who owns in-progress leads after termination, dispute resolution, governing law, and a clean process to review edits together before tracked e-signature.
title: Consulting Agreement
